# Check the key popups on a phone (A01-cookie095)

1. Install `build/Tatakikun-android-key-popup-test.apk` (on this Mac) on the phone: `~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb install -r build/Tatakikun-android-key-popup-test.apk`, or ask Claude for a release. It is debug-signed: if the phone has the release v0.6.4 installed, uninstall that first.
2. In any text field with Tatakikun up:
   - Tap letters, digits and ， 。: a popup with the character shows above your finger, with the long-press symbol small in its corner.
   - Hold g: the popup turns blue and shows &; lift: & is typed. Hold g and slide away before lifting: nothing is typed.
   - Hold ，: 、 is typed on release.
   - q, p, 1 and 0: the popup stays fully on screen.
   - Space, shift, delete, return and ?123 show no popup.
   - Type fast with two thumbs: no popup is left behind.
3. Switch the phone to dark mode and look again.

All fine: tell Claude "A01-cookie095 checked". Otherwise send a screenshot.
